summary:
Caraga's region-specific signal in the sourced material is the non-discrimination ordinance adopted by Butuan City in 2016. Butuan City is the capital of the Caraga region, and the ordinance places it among the Philippine localities that supply non-discrimination coverage on grounds including sexual orientation and gender identity through a local instrument rather than a national statute.

Caraga records no separate regional regulation of same-sex sexual activity, so a visitor there is not exposed to any regional prohibition beyond the national position. No other Caraga-specific law, regulation, enforcement practice or documented incident bearing on trans people was recorded in the inventory; a visitor to Caraga otherwise stands under the national framework of the Philippines, which the parent record carries.
tangentialFactors:
The Butuan City ordinance is a municipal instrument. It operates within Butuan City and does not, by its existence, extend non-discrimination coverage to the rest of the Caraga region, where the inventory records no provincial or regional equivalent.

Butuan City belongs to the group of Philippine cities and municipalities that have legislated locally in the absence of a national statute, which means protection for a trans person in Caraga depends on which locality they are in at a given moment rather than on a uniform regional rule.
localsOnly:
Residents of Butuan City are covered by the 2016 ordinance's non-discrimination provisions on grounds including sexual orientation and gender identity. The inventory supplies no complaint figures, penalty schedule or enforcement record under the ordinance, so its practical operation for local residents is not documented.

No Caraga-specific detention placement rule, facility practice or documented violence against trans residents was recorded, so resident-facing conditions in the region cannot be distinguished from the national picture on the sourced material.
outOfScopeNotes:
Whether any other city or province within Caraga has adopted a SOGIE or non-discrimination ordinance is unresolved. The inventory names only Butuan City for this region and does not address the other localities of Caraga.

The operative text, penalties and enforcement mechanism of the Butuan City ordinance are not reproduced in the inventory, and no data on complaints, prosecutions or the attitude of local officials toward trans residents was available. Whether the ordinance has ever been invoked is unresolved.

No Caraga-specific incidents of violence, arrest, document refusal or screening-related outing were recorded. That absence reflects the sourcing rather than a finding that none occur in the region.
